$description: Localized presentation of the BDL Standard Library items (library/std/concepts.toml), keyed by item id. English is canonical and lives in the TOML; these entries are the zh-Hans and ja names, descriptions and search tags. Generated BDL source and identifiers never change with the locale. scripts/gen_library_l10n.py writes them into the Studio ARB catalogs as libItem_* keys.
